overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board's August 31 vote on a special election for a resigning member's seat was on a topic the chair did not anticipate 48 hours ahead. No orders issued; the AG encouraged postponing unanticipated topics when possible.

allegations.summary: Two complainants alleged the Board voted on a special election to fill a Board seat at its August 31 meeting without listing the topic on the meeting notice.
allegations.key_passage: Because Chair Reinig did not anticipate Mr. Herk's resignation until the day of the meeting, we find that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law by discussing and voting on the unanticipated topic that evening.
